product_overview: Clawback Shield helps users understand Social Security overpayment notices by translating them into plain English, highlighting important dates and options, and generating a draft response letter. It also offers a free checklist, email capture, and account access for viewing saved analyses.
core_goals: Understand an SSA overpayment notice in plain English
Review key dates, options, and a draft response letter
Upload or paste notice text to start an analysis
Use a sample notice to see how the tool works
Save and review analysis history after signing in
Access a free clawback response checklist
Request a sign-in link or use a test code to access an account

features.name: Notice analysis
features.description: Users can paste or upload an SSA overpayment notice and receive a plain-English summary with the amount, key dates, response options, and a draft letter.
user_flows: Navigate to /analyze -> Paste notice text -> Request an explanation -> See a summary with amount, key dates, options, and a draft letter -> Copy or download the draft letter
Navigate to /analyze -> Choose a notice file -> Request an explanation -> See the analyzed notice summary and response details
Navigate to /analyze -> Choose a notice file -> Request an explanation -> Enter text that is too short or incomplete -> See guidance to provide a full notice for analysis

features.name: Sample notice walkthrough
features.description: Users can load a fictional sample notice into the analyzer to quickly see how the product works.
user_flows: Navigate to /analyze -> Select the sample notice option -> See the notice text populate the input area -> Request an explanation -> Review the sample analysis results

features.name: Email delivery for analysis summary
features.description: Users can opt in to receive their analysis summary by email when signing in is available or when the app status allows it.
user_flows: Navigate to /analyze -> Enable email delivery for the summary -> Submit the notice analysis -> See a status message confirming the summary request

features.name: Test code sign-in
features.description: Users can sign in with a demo test code to access an authenticated account experience.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Open the test code sign-in flow -> Enter a valid test code -> Submit the code -> Arrive at the account page as a signed-in user
Navigate to /login -> Open the test code sign-in flow -> Enter an invalid test code -> Submit the code -> See a message that the test code is not valid

features.name: Email sign-in request
features.description: Users can request an email sign-in link from the login page.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter an email address -> Request a sign-in link -> See a message that email sign-in will open soon

features.name: Account and analysis history
features.description: Signed-in users can review their plan information, remaining analyses, saved analysis history, and sign out.
user_flows: Navigate to /account -> View plan details and remaining analyses -> Open a saved analysis from history -> Review the stored result
Navigate to /account -> View account information -> Sign out -> Return to the unauthenticated experience

features.name: Free checklist and email signup
features.description: Users can read a free clawback response checklist and submit their email for updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /checklist -> Read the checklist steps -> Submit an email address to sign up -> See the signup confirmation state

routes.description: Landing page with hero, how it works, pricing (test mode), email signup
The Read my notice page - paste or upload (PDF, TXT, image) an SSA overpayment notice and get a plain-English summary, key dates, options and a draft letter
Free clawback response checklist with email capture
Email magic-link sign-in (shows "Email sign-in opens soon" when email is not configured) and "Have a test code?" demo login
Plan, remaining analyses, plans list, saved analysis history, sign out

features.name: Notice analysis (paste)
features.description: Paste notice text and click "Explain it" to get summary, amount, key dates, options, draft letter
user_interactions: See result with amount, key dates, options and DRAFT letter
Copy or download the draft letter

features.name: Notice analysis (file upload)
features.description: Upload a PDF, TXT or PNG/JPG notice; sample files at /samples/sample-notice.pdf, /samples/sample-notice.txt, /samples/sample-notice.png
user_interactions: Choose file in "Upload notice file" input

features.name: Try a sample notice
features.description: Link that fills the textarea with a fictional sample notice

features.name: Email me the summary
features.description: Checkbox; guests are invited to sign in, signed-in users see a status message (email delivery not yet configured)
user_interactions: Submit and see status message under result

features.name: Test code login
features.description: On /login open "Have a test code?", enter code, sign in as demo@clawbackshield.test (Caregiver plan)
user_interactions: Wrong code shows "That test code isn't valid."

features.name: Email sign-in request
features.description: Enter email; without email provider shows "Email sign-in opens soon"

features.name: Account and history
features.description: Shows plan, remaining analyses, saved analyses, sign out

features.name: Checklist and email signup
features.description: Free checklist page and email capture

known_limitations.issue: Guests get 1 analysis per day per IP; tests needing many analyses should sign in with the test code first
known_limitations.impact: Second guest analysis shows a limit message with "Sign in free"

known_limitations.issue: Payments (Stripe) and email delivery (Resend) are not configured
known_limitations.impact: Plan upgrade buttons do not charge; no emails are sent
